children: African Export-Import Bank (Afreximbank) has signed a $500 million financing deal with Africa Trading and Distribution Company (ATDC) to boost trade across Africa and global markets.
The new funds will serve as working capital to fund sourcing and purchasing of African products and raw materials from local producers, as well as transporting goods between countries and regions.
ATDC acquires goods from producers in Africa, manages supply chains and sells the products across various regional and overseas markets.
Besides financing, the facility will also support ATDC’s efforts to establish trade corridors across the continent, lower dependency on imports and further promote African goods globally.
(Writing by Cleofe Maceda; editing by Seban Scaria) seban.scaria@lseg.com

title: Afreximbank extends $500mln financing to ATDC to boost trade in Africa, global markets
